verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching this story is a community note on a free-plan search limit, which mentions snoozed emails still arriving back in the inbox. That implies a snooze feature exists, but nothing documents it first-party. There is no evidence of follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies; scheduled send and todos are different capabilities. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of snooze, any evidence of no-reply follow-up reminders or auto-resurfacing, and hands-on corroboration.
